summary: Iteration 6 fully green. Added 10 new backend tests (PUT /api/team ×4: name/email/pwd change + login, keep-old-password, dup email 400, member forbidden 403; PUT /api/work-types regression ×1; Weekly reports ×1 combined: generate + list + Excel structure (3 sheets, PieChart present, Fatturazione headers) + 404 + second-generate 400; Cron auth ×3: no-auth 401, wrong secret 401, correct secret + X-Webhook-Id → 200 accepted). Total 45/45 backend passing. Frontend verified: (a) header shows admin name 'Tipografia'; (b) Impostazioni — 10 tipo edit buttons and 6+ member edit buttons; inline edit of a work-type name persists then reverts cleanly; inline edit of a member name+password persists and appears in list; (c) Dashboard 'Report Settimanali' section renders with 'Archivia Settimana' button — end-to-end: seeded TEST_ job → complete → invoice via API-in-page, clicked Archivia, new weekly-report-row appeared with periodo/lavori/entrate/fatturato and per-tipo chip, success toast 'Report settimanale generato e lavori archiviati' visible, Excel button downloaded a valid .xlsx (8040 bytes, correct filename report_settimana_YYYY-MM-DD.xlsx). Excel structure validated via openpyxl (sheets Lavori/Riepilogo Tipologie/Fatturazione; PieChart present in Riepilogo; Fatturazione header row matches expected 13 columns). Cron endpoint tested at API level (curl-equivalent) with real WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET from /app/backend/.env. All TEST_ data (jobs/clients/members/weekly_reports) cleaned up via API/pymongo.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/cron/weekly-archive correctly acks with 200 immediately and enqueues via BackgroundTasks + idempotency via X-Webhook-Id in db.cron_runs — matches Emergent cron rules.

download_weekly_report_excel: openpyxl imported lazily inside handler — good (avoids startup cost when no reports). PieChart references Riepilogo Tipologie range so Excel/LibreOffice will auto-update the chart when totals are edited (native chart, spec met).
update_member: rejects duplicate email via {'_id': {'$ne': target['_id']}} — correct. Password only rehashed if body.password truthy — matches 'password opzionale' spec.
create_weekly_report: filters archived + weekly_archived != True and marks jobs after insertion — properly idempotent for manual re-runs (second call returns None → 400 as expected).
Cron auth uses secrets.compare_digest — constant-time comparison, good.
Minor: reports list endpoint has no delete route; test cleanup relies on direct pymongo access. If exposed to a UI admin action later, add DELETE /api/weekly-reports/{id} (admin only).
